sources.prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION transparent 3x3 sprite source atlas, nine separate cells, for a Korean RTS game's bean organism organically metamorphosing into a makeshift living headquarters. Use the references: image 1 fixes the pale ivory-green bulky bean organism anatomy and painterly clean outline style; image 2 fixes the final simple leaf-canopy headquarters. New drawn construction stages, NOT a diagram or preview. Every cell will be used as animation source or bind-pose reference. No text, numbers, arrows, grid lines, background or external shadow. All nine cells separate, aligned in three exact equal rows and columns with generous transparent gutters.

The motion is a 15-second living hatchery-like growth: settle and close eyes at one-cell size, hold and throb, burst to a distinct two-cell wide cocoon, hold and throb, then become a three-cell wide sealed headquarters, finally two organic door membranes peel apart. The character is solemn and working, NOT happy. NO smile, mouth, cheek blush, raised happy crescent eyes, arms, feet, legs, legs disguised as roots, antennae, or new ornaments. Closed eyes must be two nearly STRAIGHT horizontal dark green resting eyelids. Consistent camera front/three-quarter top down, light upper left. Wide low center of mass.

ROW 1 complete drawn key poses:
1) One-cell bean settled flat on a thin radial root-bed, leaf pair folded inward, eyes firmly closed with flat horizontal lids. Familiar broad bean.
2) Mutated two-cell cocoon: broad low seed sac, TWO strong asymmetric anatomical lobes separated by a vertical cotyledon seam; small folded leaf crown, thicker vascular seed skin and pale green ribs. No recognizable building roof yet. Eyes have withdrawn into the seed skin. It is the same living bean, now a distinct swollen construction stage, not an enlarged neutral blob.
3) Nearly finished headquarters matching reference 2, grown from the cocoon, THREE-cell canopy shape with thick organic seed-skin doors filling the front opening. Simple temporary structure, low roof, no fancy decorations. A strong central seam promises the entrance will open.

ROW 2 independent source parts, complete contours and hidden surfaces:
4) ONLY the complete one-cell bean BODY from pose 1, including its folded leaf crown and flat sleeping eyes, no floor or root-bed. Exactly matching pose 1.
5) ONLY the complete two-cell cocoon BODY from pose 2, with lobes and vascular ribs, no floor or root-bed. Exactly matching pose 2. Broad width about 1.5 times its height.
6) ONLY a flat oval living root-bed: thin pale green seed-fiber mat with short radial roots flat against the ground, fully connected continuous oval pad, no upright roots, no body. Usable at 1, 2 and 3 tile stages.

ROW 3 independent source parts:
7) LEFT half of the convex closed seed-skin entrance from pose 3, detached: large pale ivory-green living leaf membrane, curved outer edge and straight vertical center seam edge on its RIGHT. Full thick curved contour and overlap padding, no building.
8) RIGHT half of the SAME entrance, straight seam on its LEFT. Matching mirrored geometry and lighting from left above. No building.
9) ONLY a pair of nearly perfectly STRAIGHT dark green sleeping eyelids: two short flat horizontal strokes. Absolutely no curved happy ^ eyes or smiling expression.

Transparent background. Preserve restrained clean game illustration; large readable silhouettes, not detailed noise. No components touching adjacent cells.

Create a PRODUCTION 3x3 transparent sprite source atlas, nine separate equal cells, for a red-capped mushroom organism organically metamorphosing into a building. Input image 1 is the exact unit anatomy, material, outline and palette reference. Image 2 fixes the simple temporary headquarters design. This is final game animation source artwork, NOT a diagram or presentation. All nine cells separated by generous transparent gutters, three exact equal rows and columns. NO labels, text, numbers, grid lines, arrows, colored background, haze, halos or external shadows. Real alpha transparency outside clean solid sprite contours. Front/three-quarter top-down game camera, upper-left lighting, clean readable painterly shapes matching references. Grounded, wide, heavy silhouette. No smile, mouth, blushing cheeks or curved happy ^ eyes. No legs, feet, arms or antennae. Stage one eyelids are straight horizontal lines.

A 15-second, three-stage organic construction: one-cell settled body holds and works, bursts into a distinct two-cell cocoon and holds, bursts to a near-three-cell sealed building, then its entrance opens. Actual occupied plot is always 3x3. Each stage has its own drawn silhouette; stage two is a mutation of its organism.

ROW 1 complete drawn key poses:
1) Stage one on a small ground-bed. Familiar ivory mushroom stalk and broad red cap, crouched and settled, two FLAT dark horizontal sleeping eyelids, mouthless. A tiny closed gill seam appears under its cap.
2) Stage two on a wider ground-bed. A distinct broad low two-cell fungal cocoon: thick RED cap above paired swelling ivory gill-sacs, very short thick stalk rooted into the bed. The sacs have broad readable pleated gill folds and a central vertical seam; the cap skin is smooth, NOT dotted. No eyes in stage two, no building posts yet. Pulse belongs to the pale gill sacs underneath the cap, not to legs.
3) Stage three sealed near-complete headquarters. Simple nearly complete mushroom canopy headquarters from reference 2, sealed by two ivory fungal web curtains attached under the red cap, the entrance is shut by their vertical center seam. Plain makeshift colony shelter.
ROW 2 complete independent source parts:
4) ONLY the complete stage-one BODY from pose 1, no ground-bed. Exactly matching anatomy and pose, including straight sleeping eyelids.
5) ONLY the complete stage-two cocoon BODY from pose 2, no ground-bed. Exactly the same lobes, seams and material. Fully opaque within the body's silhouette. No gaps outside intentional seams. Wide shape about 1.6 times its height.
6) ONLY the ground-bed: a continuous flat oval ivory mycelium mat, short fibers pressed flat against the ground, no pebbles, no eggs, no objects. Fully connected single flat foundation layer, no body.
ROW 3 complete independent source parts:
7) LEFT half of the thick ivory fungal web curtain: rounded outer edge, STRAIGHT vertical center-seam edge on RIGHT; faint pleated gill veins, not a face. Detached from building, draw whole contour and overlap area.
8) Matching RIGHT half of that curtain, vertical seam on LEFT. Exact paired scale, palette and contours, detached from building.
9) ONLY a pair of short nearly perfectly STRAIGHT horizontal dark sleeping eyelids. Two short flat strokes. No happy crescent or ^ shape.
Keep restrained materials and simple shapes, no extra decoration or items inside buildings. Pure alpha=0 transparent background between every sprite.
